notes.title: Update delays...
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is just a notice that the 2.0 update will NOT be coming out tomorrow, May 27th. I am unsure about when it will be released but it will be relatively soon. This does mean that I am still open to suggestions. Send any you have to the "Update Suggestions" discussion. Thank you all again!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32327305/c031dc707ce3955f674fda357931ce90b1e805ef.png

-Flashynurav

notes.title: The Update Has Begun...
notes.notes:
Hey there! You may have noticed that steam achievements now exist for this game. However, they are currently unobtainable. When the update is released they will be. More and more changes will begin to take effect on the store page. Something is creeping...

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32327305/c031dc707ce3955f674fda357931ce90b1e805ef.png

-Flashynurav

notes.title: Seek Or Die Version V.1.3 Out Now!
notes.notes:
This game version addressed a HUGE bug in "Part II: Die" in which the monster wouldn't spawn. It also made the camera system a bit more intuitive. Thank you for checking out this game! We are 12k downloads and 122k views deep!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32327305/c031dc707ce3955f674fda357931ce90b1e805ef.png.
